description: Type-specific evidence decay rates for temporal stickiness (Enhancement 5)

decay_model.description: Exponential decay with type-specific half-life and floor
decay_model.rationale: Different evidence types have different persistence characteristics

production_usage.description: Production usage is very sticky - once in production, likely to remain
production_usage.rationale: Production systems rarely get decommissioned quickly

pilot_or_poc.description: PoCs can stall or be cancelled; moderate decay
pilot_or_poc.rationale: Many pilots don't progress to production

open_source_contribution.rationale: OSS participation indicates ongoing technical investment

membership_or_participation.rationale: Membership alone doesn't guarantee ongoing commitment

vendor_proxy_signal.description: Vendor relationships tend to be multi-year contracts

hiring_signal.description: Job postings are highly transient signals
hiring_signal.rationale: Positions get filled; priorities change quickly

strategic_intent.rationale: Strategy can change; requires validation through action

tier1.rationale: Official sources more reliable over time

historical.note: Can provide context but cannot drive classification

usage_notes: Apply decay formula when calculating evidence weights
Combine with tier modifiers for final weight
Evidence older than historical threshold provides context only
For high-confidence claims, require at least one 'current' source
